description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art character with green hair: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask, on the forehead of the figure seen from the front: the long top of the undercut swept forward and to one side as a thick fringe across the forehead, coming down from the hair above to just above the eyes, removing the broad bare forehead band, allowing small skin gaps between locks; keep every lock and its outline above the eyes, in the same style as the rest of the hairstyle, in big bold locks. The same bright grass green as the hair above, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. Do not change the eyes, the face below them, the long pointed ears, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
